_comment: Style moods people pick during setup. 'prompts' are what the AI matches against product photos; 'desc' is what people read.

vibes.desc: Heritage fabrics, quiet polish, nothing shouts
prompts: old money style clothing, understated heritage elegance
classic cashmere and wool pieces in navy, camel and cream

vibes.desc: Oxford shirts, rugby stripes, varsity knits
